posts.zh:
Gemini-Eyes 已收录到 DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store。接入 gemini.google.com 的 MCP 桥：图片/视频视觉识别、Imagen 生图、Veo 生视频与历史对话管理，复用浏览器登录态，无需 API Key。

posts.en:
Gemini-Eyes is now listed on the DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store. MCP bridge to gemini.google.com: vision analysis of images and videos, Imagen image and Veo video generation, and conversation management using the logged-in browser session with no API key.

Source and install details: https://deeplugin.store/plugins/deeplugin-5b948afeba3e7e3bb101.html
